finding: The routing at the wave close covers a QA finding that the gate-check step filed. The core-artifact-ownership Outline 'The test-strategy agent resolves a QA finding in one of two ways' lets the test-strategy agent keep QA-0013 open and change its owner to planning-agent, because a test is missing. Wave 1 has closed when that spawn returns, and no Scenario says whether the implementation agent then runs dispatch add QA-0013 before dispatch prepare-wave 2. As written, QA-0013 stays open with run feature/login until premerge-check dev refuses the run. Add a step to the Scenario 'The next wave waits until every spawn of the test-strategy agent returns' that routes each returned finding by its new owner. Owner: requirements-agent.
why_this_severity: premerge-check dev refuses the run and names QA-0013, so nothing merges wrong, and the plain reading of 'routes the open QA findings by owner' lets the agent route QA-0013 again (no to fails_purpose); the writer of RL-12-IT-01 must decide the second routing without a Scenario (raises_cost).
